name_text: Name: Magdalena Augusta von Sachsen-Gotha-Altenburg, Magdalena Augusta van Anhalt Zerbst, AKA (Magdalena August of Anhalt-Zerbst, Grandmother of King Geor (b. - 1740)
immediate_family_text: Immediate Family: Daughter of Karl Wilhelm von Anhalt-Zerbst, Fürst zu Anhalt-Zerbst and Princess Sophia of Saxe-Weissenfels or Sophie van Saksen AKA Sophia von Sachsen-Weißenfels OR Sophie of Wettin, Princess of Saxe-Weissenfels, Princess Consort of Anhalt-Zerbst, AND Sophia Wettin Sachsen Weissenfels Wife of Frederick II Wettin, 8XGGF; of Saxsen-Gotha-Altenburg,, Duke, of Saksen-Gotha-Altenburg. Half sister of Fürst Johann August von Anhalt-Zerbst and Princess Magdalena Augusta of Anhalt-Zerbst
